notes: 54-class independent comparison proposal with 42 distinct featured bosses. Each boss appears as a suggested primary at least once and twice among 162 suggested selections. Existing approved boss and status fields remain unchanged. suggestedPrimary and suggestedAlternatives are planning-only, NOT approved pairings or artwork. All historical encounters retained. Each suggested primary and alternative has a short editorial rationale in pairingReasons. Reasons explain aesthetics/scene composition, not approval or completion. Approved existing pairings remain untouched. Kai and Mayrin added to independent recommendations on November 15, 2026. Kai primary for Zero / alternative Hayato; Mayrin primary for Phantom / alternative Sia Astelle. 44 bosses each primary at least once and appearing twice across 162 slots. All prior user-approved existing pairings remain unchanged. Boss display naming uses Vellum; Chaos is a difficulty modifier rather than a separate boss identity. November 16: Pathfinder × Gollux selected (not rendered); Blaze Wizard × Vellum and Phantom × Mayrin final artwork approved; previous primaries retained in historicalEncounters. Gallery image paths for new finals not verified.
